overall_policy.description: Edinburgh publishes 2027 A100 academic entry requirements, UCAT/SJT requirements, resit policy, English language requirements, graduate applicant policy and non-academic application guidance. FOI-derived evidence now supplies formula scoring fields used after eligibility screening.

scottish.notes: Scottish requirements are official. FOI-derived scoring is stored under Stage 2; do not infer missing intermediate academic bands.

btec.notes: BTEC acceptance was not verified in Step 1 official evidence.

access_to_he.notes: Access to HE acceptance was not verified in Step 1 official evidence.

degree.minimum_classification: UK 2:1 honours degree or international equivalent
degree.non_science_degree_condition: Applicants with non-science degrees must also have SQA Higher, A level, or equivalent, in Chemistry at B.
degree.notes: Graduates applying for undergraduate medicine do not qualify for widening access offer policy unless care-experienced or asylum seeker/refugee status applies.

post_16.notes: Only qualification routes verified in Step 1 official evidence are populated. Other routes remain unextracted.

exemptions.policy: UCAT exemptions are considered only in very exceptional circumstances with prior agreement before application. Applications without UCAT are not considered unless a formal exemption has been granted in advance.
exemptions.effect: Exempt applicants are awarded the average UCAT score and SJT banding achieved within their respective fee-status group in the current cohort.

values.value: 1 August in the year of application

official_deadline_conflict.notes: Do not resolve without further official clarification.

ucat.notes: UCAT is required for 2027 entry. Minimum total cutoff is 1850 except Plus Flag applicants are considered with any UCAT total score. FOI-derived evidence supplies fee-cohort UCAT decile scoring for Stage 2.

sjt.notes: SJT banding is scored and added to academic and UCAT scoring for ranking. FOI-derived evidence supplies Bands 1-3 points; Band 4 applicants are not considered.

conditions: All examination grades must be obtained at the first attempt of each subject.
Applicants with resit qualifications are not entered into the selection system except in very exceptional circumstances.
Verified evidence for exceptional circumstances must be provided prior to UCAS application.
For modular A levels with formal certificated AS examinations, AS results must be achieved in the first sitting and AS module resits are not normally permitted.
resits.notes: Official resit policy extracted from the 2027 entry requirements page.

accepted_tests.notes: IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted.
TOEFL MyBest Score is not accepted.
Stored exactly as published in the official evidence report; do not reinterpret without further official review.
Oxford ELLT Skill Retake is not accepted.

school_qualification_routes: IB Standard Level English at 5; English ab initio is not accepted
english_language.notes: Edinburgh states all applicants, including UK nationals, must prove English language ability. English test recency rules are published but not fully modelled for engine calculation.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Fitness to practise and health clearance checks are official. DBS/criminal-record check handling was not extracted in Step 1 official evidence.

personal_statement.notes: Personal statement is not formally assessed but may provide guidance when shortlisting for Assessment Days and is essential preparation if invited.

reference_policy.notes: UCAS reference is described as important, but no official Edinburgh scoring formula is published.

work_experience.notes: Official personal statement page advises reflection on career exploration and quality of experience over quantity; no separate work-experience threshold is published in Step 1 evidence.

ranking_factors.notes: Official pre-assessment day scoring page gives a route-specific academic score out of 20.
Official scoring uses UCAT cognitive deciles by fee category. Current live deciles are not known; stored 2025 Edinburgh admissions-statistics deciles are historical estimates only.

The official pre-assessment day scoring page confirms SJT contributes up to 6 points and Band 4 is automatic rejection. Exact Band 1–3 point values are verified FOI evidence and are not published on the public page.

score_components.notes: Official route-specific academic score out of 20.
Official UCAT fee-cohort decile score out of 14.
SJT score out of 6. The public page confirms the weighting and Band 4 exclusion; exact Band 1–3 values come from verified FOI evidence.

total_score.formula: Pre-assessment score = Academic score out of 20 + UCAT cognitive decile score out of 14 + SJT score out of 6
total_score.final_weighting: Pre-assessment score contributes 50% of the final overall score; Assessment Day/MMI contributes 50%.
total_score.notes: Official pre-assessment total out of 40. Historical fee-cohort deciles must be labelled as estimates when live deciles are unavailable.

historical_decile_estimate.disclaimer: UCAT decile estimated using latest published Edinburgh 2025 admissions statistics, not current live applicant pool.

sjt_points.public_source_confirmation: The official University page confirms SJT contributes 6 points to the pre-interview score and Band 4 is automatically rejected, but does not publish exact Band 1–3 values.
sjt_points.exact_values_source_note: Band 1 = 6.0, Band 2 = 4.5 and Band 3 = 3.0 are verified FOI values, not publicly published values.

point_bands.condition: All grades >=7/A with up to four grades 8/9
All grades >=7/A with five to seven grades 8/9
All grades 8/9 across the best eight
Grade B in Biology OR Chemistry
Grade B in any other subject
All >=A plus up to four A grades
AAAAB / AAABB with no Advanced Highers
AAAAA + BB Advanced Highers with Chemistry at AH B or higher

ib_component.final_score_note: The component total is already the final doubled academic score out of 20. Do not double or multiply it again.

calculation.notes: Official scoring enables pre-assessment score calculation from applicant academic profile, Edinburgh historical UCAT decile estimate or supplied current fee-cohort decile, and SJT band. Historical deciles must not be labelled as current-cycle live deciles.

pre_interview_score.formula: Academic score out of 20 + international-cohort UCAT cognitive decile score out of 14 + SJT score out of 6
pre_interview_score.notes: Eligible international applicants are ranked highest to lowest by total pre-interview score out of 40, not by UCAT alone.

ib.notes: The 20-point component total is already the final doubled academic score. Minimum entry requirements are separate and are never inputs to this calculation.

ucat.notes: The 1650 value is the verified 2026 UCAT eligibility threshold, not a fixed interview cut-off. Edinburgh does not publish a fixed international interview boundary.

sjt.public_source_note: The official University page confirms the 7.5% contribution and Band 4 automatic rejection; exact Band 1–3 point values are verified FOI evidence and are not publicly published.

international_selection.notes: International scoring and ranking only. Home, Scottish and Rest of UK logic is unchanged.

exceptions: Plus Flag applicants are considered with any UCAT total score.
thresholds.notes: Official minimum UCAT total cutoff for 2027 academic entry.
No applicant, regardless of widening-access eligibility, is considered with SJT Band 4.

selection_adjustments.notes: Plus Flag applicants are considered with any UCAT total score and receive a 10% uplift to original UCAT total score.
Official UCAT page says UCAT bursary applicants receive the same concessions as Plus Flag applicants.
Flag applicants must meet the cutoff score and receive a 5% uplift to original UCAT total score.
Scottish-domiciled applicants with permanent residence within the second lowest SIMD quintile must meet the cutoff and receive a 10% uplift.

tie_breakers.value: Individual UCAT section scores may be looked at again where applicants have the same ranked score and limited places remain.
tie_breakers.notes: FOI-derived evidence confirms UCAT subtests may be used as tie-breakers. Exact tie-break sequence/order remains unresolved.

output_band_policy.notes: Bands are ApplySmart guidance based on the official pre-assessment formula and clearly labelled historical fee-cohort decile estimates; they are not university-published labels.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: FOI-derived evidence confirms academic, UCAT decile and SJT scoring are used for a pre-interview score out of 50. Final ranking is out of 100 and requires a supplied interview score out of 50.

criteria.description: Care-experienced applicants are referenced in official selection/contextual evidence.

adjustments.notes: No applicant with SJT Band 4 is considered, regardless of widening-access eligibility.
